name: How long does finish carpentry installation typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does finish carpentry installation typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of finish carpentry installation varies greatly depending on the project's size and complexity. Installing basic baseboards and door casings in a few rooms might take a few days. More extensive projects involving custom built-ins, multiple types of molding, or detailed wainscoting could extend to several weeks. Factors like material availability, site readiness, and the number of carpenters on the job also influence the timeline. We provide a detailed project schedule with our estimates.
acceptedAnswer.description: Finish carpentry duration depends on project size and complexity, ranging from a few days for basic trim to several weeks for custom built-ins and intricate work.
